33: Why are their names called - of the mules - yemim, as it is written (Genesis 36:24), "who found the yemim."
None have asked me: Rabbi Chanina was a physician. And in Tractate Yoma (49a:10) in [the chapter entitled] Hotziu Lo, they bring it from here (that he was a physician).
And survive: It is implied that the one struck dies.
And healed: [The verb] is in the feminine, and it is referring to the wound (and not the man), as the wound does not heal.
